source_refs.note: Lipoproteins: a main subheading of 4.9 Conjugated molecules, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 127-128.

blocks.text: Lipoproteins biomolecules ki woh qisam hain jo lipids aur proteins ke darmiyan hydrophobic interactions (pani se door rehne wali kashish) se bante hain, covalent ya ionic bonds se nahin. Kitab ke mutabiq lipoproteins har qisam ki plasma membrane ka bunyadi structural dhancha (framework) hain. Khoon mein lipids very low-density lipoproteins (VLDL) ki shakal mein le jaye jate hain.
